about: The selectors that only later headers of the plugin SDK declare and the application answers, by class. types: for each, the type encoding the Objective-C compiler gives the declaration of those headers on arm64, without the frame offsets; tests/test-later-plugin-sdk-selectors.py compares each with the method the running application has. kept: those that are a property the application has no use for, which it keeps with the object and reads back, and which the test sets and reads. Written, from the headers published as text, by tools/plugin-sdk-selector-sweep.py: its table command lists the kept ones with their types, and its encodings command gives the types of those answered by hand.
